name: ARN Smart Image Optimizer
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart Image Optimizer converts your JPG and PNG images to WebP or AVIF on your own server and serves the optimized copies to visitors. Original images are never changed.

Conversion runs in the background: new uploads are converted after WordPress has saved them, and existing images are converted by a bulk job that you can pause, resume or cancel. Image processing runs fully locally and does not need an account or any external service.

🚀 Features

  • ✅ Convert JPG and PNG images to WebP or AVIF
  • ✅ Automatic background conversion after upload
  • ✅ Bulk conversion as a background job with live progress; pause, resume and cancel it from the dashboard
  • ✅ Media Library bulk actions: “WebPix: convert” and “WebPix: regenerate copies”
  • ✅ Missing copies are completed automatically after an update or a format change
  • ✅ Media Library conversion status column and media window details
  • ✅ WebP or AVIF delivery for <img> and <source> tags (src, srcset and common lazy-load attributes), with each image size served from its own copy
  • ✅ A copy that is larger than its original is never served
  • ✅ Storage card: disk space used by the copies, and review and deletion of copies whose original no longer exists
  • ✅ Basic media folders: create, subfolders, rename, move, delete, drag and drop, upload into the open folder, and folder list in the media window
  • ✅ Adjustable WebP quality; AVIF copies use a fixed standard quality
  • ✅ Conversion statistics and coverage on one dashboard
  • ✅ Local-only image processing
  • ✅ Settings > ARN Free AI, the shared AI connection screen of ARN Free plugins (provider, your own API key, model, usage and monthly limits); the image optimizer itself sends no AI requests

🛡️ Why ARN Smart Image Optimizer?

  • Original images stay untouched; copies are stored in uploads/arn-image-optimizer.
  • Conversion never runs inside the upload request or a visitor request; background work runs only while there is work to do.
  • Copies are written to a temporary file first, so a half-written copy is never served.
  • Deleting an image also deletes its copies.
  • Works on WordPress Multisite; every site keeps its own settings and data.

⭐ Pro Version

ARN Smart WebPix is the Pro version, available on arnsmart.com. It adds, among others: WebP and AVIF together, quality presets, picture-tag delivery, CSS background and builder image delivery, LCP and image dimension tools, advanced media folders, cloud storage, watermarks and AI media tools.

If ARN Smart WebPix is active and licensed on the same site, this plugin pauses itself (no conversion, no delivery, no Media Library column or folder panel, no entry under Settings > ARN Free AI) and says so on its dashboard. Its settings, copies and folders are kept, and it continues when the Pro version is no longer active.

External services

Image conversion, delivery and media folders run on your own server and use no external service.

ARN Free AI (Settings > ARN Free AI). The plugin bundles ARN Free AI, the shared AI settings screen of ARN Free plugins. ARN Smart Image Optimizer itself sends no images, no AI requests and no site data to any AI provider, and it does not contact any ARN server. Only when a site administrator chooses a provider on that screen and clicks “Test connection” (one short fixed test prompt, no site content) or “Load models” (the provider’s model list) is a request sent, with the administrator’s own API key, to that provider only, at that moment. The API key is stored encrypted in the WordPress database. No data is sent to any other provider.

  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy

If WordPress AI is chosen instead, the test request goes through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate ARN Smart Image Optimizer.
  3. Open the ARN WebPix menu in the WordPress admin. Settings, bulk conversion, storage and maintenance tools are all on this dashboard.
  4. Choose WebP or AVIF and start a bulk conversion for your existing images.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account?

No. The plugin works locally without an account.

Does the plugin send site data to ARN Smart or any other service?

No. The plugin sends no images or site data to ARN Smart or to any other service, and the Poppins font of the dashboard is included in the plugin. The only outbound requests are the “Test connection” and “Load models” buttons of the shared Settings > ARN Free AI screen, sent to the AI provider an administrator chose, when the administrator clicks them (see External services).

Which formats are supported?

JPG, JPEG and PNG images can be converted to WebP or AVIF. WebP needs WebP support in GD or ImageMagick; AVIF needs AVIF encoding support in GD (imageavif()) or ImageMagick on the server.

Can I set the AVIF quality?

No. AVIF copies use a fixed standard quality. The WebP quality can be set from 1 to 100.

Can I convert existing Media Library images?

Yes. Start a bulk conversion on the dashboard, or select images in the Media Library list view and use the “WebPix: convert” bulk action.

Does the plugin replace original images?

No. Original images are never changed. Optimized copies are stored separately.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

By default your settings, statistics, folders and copies are kept. To remove them, turn on “Delete plugin data on uninstall” on the dashboard before deleting the plugin; the copies in uploads/arn-image-optimizer are removed only if “Also delete the WebP/AVIF copies” is also on. Original images and data of other plugins are never removed. On Multisite every site follows its own choice. With “Delete plugin data on uninstall” on, the shared ARN Free AI settings, saved API keys and usage history of the sites where it is on are removed too, but only when no other installed ARN Free plugin (active or not) still uses them.

Is the plugin compatible with shared hosting environments?

Yes. Background conversion runs in small steps with a time budget, so it suits standard WordPress hosting.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Added: bulk conversion runs as a background job with live progress; pause, resume and cancel it from the dashboard.
  • Added: Media Library bulk actions “WebPix: convert” and “WebPix: regenerate copies”.
  • Added: after an update or a format change the library is checked and missing copies are created automatically in the background.
  • Added: storage card shows the disk space of the WebP/AVIF copies and lets you review and delete copies whose original no longer exists.
  • Added: basic media folders (create, subfolders, rename, move, delete, drag and drop, upload into the open folder, folder list in the media window).
  • Added: Settings > ARN Free AI, the shared AI connection screen of ARN Free plugins (provider, your own API key stored encrypted, model, usage and monthly limits). ARN Smart Image Optimizer itself sends no AI requests; nothing is sent until an administrator uses “Test connection” or “Load models” on that screen.
  • Changed: every image size is served with its own copy (srcset and thumbnails); a copy larger than its original is never served; delivery covers the <img> and <source> tags of the whole page, not only post content.
  • Changed: copies are written to a temporary file first; deleting an image also deletes its copies.
  • Changed: missing copies seen on the site are converted later in the background in small batches; failed files are not retried for 24 hours.
  • Changed: AVIF copies use a fixed standard quality; the AVIF quality field was removed. WebP quality stays adjustable.
  • Changed: uninstall keeps your data by default. Data is removed only when “Delete plugin data on uninstall” is on, copies only when “Also delete the WebP/AVIF copies” is also on, and folders of other plugins are never touched. With “Delete plugin data on uninstall” on, the shared ARN Free AI settings and usage history are removed as well when no other installed ARN Free plugin uses them.
  • Changed: the plugin pauses itself while ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) is active and licensed on the same site.
  • Changed: “Clear Old Logs” removes only this plugin’s log entries older than 30 days and no longer flushes the site’s object cache.
  • Fixed: database tables are installed once per version and on every site of a network.
  • Fixed: PHP 8.5 deprecation of imagedestroy().
  • Removed: the separate settings, tools and statistics pages that were no longer shown; everything is on the dashboard.

1.0.2

  • Added AVIF output and AVIF quality control to the free version.
  • Deferred upload conversion until after WordPress finishes saving attachment metadata.
  • Fixed upload failures in post and page editor media flows.
  • Added stale-variant detection after WordPress Image Editor changes.
  • Updated statistics to follow the selected output format.
  • Corrected the install ZIP root folder.
  • Tested compatibility target updated to WordPress 7.1.

1.0.1

  • Tested compatibility with WordPress 7.0.
  • Improvements for the updated WordPress admin interface.
  • Minor optimization workflow improvements.
  • General stability improvements.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • WebP conversion engine.
  • Media Library integration.
  • Bulk conversion tools.
  • Smart optimization workflow.
  • WebP delivery support.
